user: What information do you need before filing the dispute?
answer:
To file the dispute on TX-0401, I need two things from you:

1. **Confirmation that TX-0401 is the duplicate charge.** Both TechMart Online charges are EUR 240.00, so I need you to say which one is the extra payment. TX-0401 (2026-07-20) is eligible with a deadline of 2026-09-18. I have not checked TX-0402 (2026-07-14). Its window appears to have closed around 2026-09-12, but I would need to run an eligibility check to confirm that.

2. **Confirmation to proceed.** A dispute cannot be reversed once opened. Once you confirm, I will file it under reason code duplicate_charge for the full EUR 240.00 unless you want a different amount.

I do not need any other details to file it. Once you reply, I will open the dispute.
